name: ZX_DETERMINING_FACTORS_B_
description: This table stores Tax Determining Factors

columns.name: DETERMINING_FACTOR_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor code

columns.name: DETERMINING_FACTOR_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor class code

columns.name: VALUE_SET
columns.description: Value set associated with the Determining Factor.

columns.name: TAX_PARAMETER_CODE
columns.description: Tax parameter code for the determining factor

columns.name: DATA_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the determining factor. Possible values are DATE, NUMERIC and ALPHANUMERIC.

columns.name: TAX_FUNCTION_CODE
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_DET_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N to indicate whether the determining factor can be used for tax regime determination

columns.name: TAX_SUMMARIZATION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N to Indicate whether the determining factor can be used for tax summarization

columns.name: TAX_RULES_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N to indicate whether the determining factor can be used to define tax rules

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N to indicate whether the determining factor can be used in a taxable basis formula

columns.name: TAX_CALCULATION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N to indicate whether the determining factor can be used in a tax calculation formula

columns.name: INTERNAL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N to indicate whether the determining factor is for internal use only

columns.name: RECORD_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N to indicate whether the determining factor can be recorded for reporting purpose

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of this record by a concurrent program

columns.name: DETERMINING_FACTOR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: REPORTING_USAGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the determine factor is used for reporting rule conditions. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: DEFAULTING_USAGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the determine factor is used for defaulting rule conditions. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
